Jesse (Sales): Quick sync — Helio Logistics is ready to run a 3-week POC. Need to align on success criteria, data access, redaction, and a minimal sandbox network layout. They asked about pricing for Hosted vs Dedicated for the trial. Can we list blockers and owners?
Maya - Solutions: Proposed success criteria: 1) latency <= 600ms p50 for 512-token prompts; 2) end-to-end throughput to sustain 5 concurrent editors; 3) semantic search recall >= 0.85 on their 5k sample docs; 4) redaction verifies no PII in logs. Also recommend 2 eval prompt sets: retrieval QA + rewrite prompts.
Alex (AM): Customer will give a 5k-document sample extract (anonymized). They prefer S3 staging in their AWS account (us-west-2) with a read-only role. They asked if we can support KMS-wrapped objects and for audit logs.
Sam SRE: For connectivity we'll need either: a) temporary VPC peering + IAM role for cross-account S3 read only, or b) presigned S3 URLs uploaded to our intake bucket. VPC peering requires a security review and ~2 business days to configure. Presigned is faster (same-day).
Priya - Eng: On the runtime side: we'll run a mid-size Llama-variant (8-bit quant) for the POC to hit cost/latency targets. I recommend enabling prefix KV caching and a 64-token warmup to stabilize p50. We'll also provide a small eval harness to run their 100 prompt tests.
Jesse (Sales): Pricing question from procurement — can you give a rough delta between hosted trial over 3 weeks vs reserved dedicated for the pilot? They want to know risk/cost tradeoffs.
Maya - Solutions: Rough numbers (order-of-magnitude): Hosted trial: ~$3k-$6k (usage + small infra). Dedicated reserved instance (monthly) for pilot: $18k-$30k/month depending on throughput. We can do a short burst-reserved for the pilot to reduce commit. I'll confirm exact quotes with finance.
Sam SRE: Security Qs flagged by their InfoSec: data residency, KMS integration, retention of logs, redaction validation. For redaction we need their sample plus a regex and named-entity list they consider sensitive. We can run automated scrub + human spot check. Example rule we run: `/(\b\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}\b)|([A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,})/g` (SSN and emails).
Alex (AM): Customer also asked for SLA during pilot. We can offer best-effort 99.9 for hosted trial, SLA only on Dedicated. They want to start next Monday (6 business days). Is that feasible?
Priya - Eng: Timeline: Day 0-1: credentials + sample upload. Day 2: provision sandbox + ingest pipeline. Day 3-5: run ingest + redaction pass + smoke evals. Week 2: run full eval sets and tuning. Week 3: UX eval with customer team and handoff. If they pick presigned URLs we can compress Day 0-2 into same-day start.
Jesse (Sales): Blockers: (1) InfoSec signoff on redaction rules (owner: Helio + Sam), (2) S3 access method (owner: Alex), (3) procurement on trial spend guardrails (owner: Jesse/Maya), (4) model choice approval (owner: Priya).
Maya - Solutions: Action items: - Alex: get IAM role or presigned flow decision by EOD tomorrow. - Helio: upload sample + sensitive field list. - Priya: prepare eval harness & provide baseline numbers by Wed. - Sam: prepare network checklist and redaction runbook.
Alex (AM): I'll confirm S3 workflow and provide role ARNs or presigned URL process by EOD. Also looping in infra-bot to provision a sandbox project once we have the sample.
infra-bot: sandbox-project `heliopoc-1892` queued — will allocate compute once S3 access is confirmed. ETA: 4 hours after confirmation. :gear:
Sam SRE: Quick note on logs/retention: We can keep request logs for the POC for 30 days in a customer-scoped logging bucket and support encrypted-at-rest. We will not retain prompt text in plain logs; only hashed keys unless customer approves otherwise.
Jesse (Sales): Great — I'll send this checklist to Helio and ask for the sample + redaction list. If anyone has objections to the timeline or criteria, flag now. Otherwise we'll treat this as agreed and move to scheduling intake call tomorrow. :calendar:
__note: This document is a single Slack thread stored as a continuous string. It includes short Slack-style messages, @mentions, a code regex snippet, a bot message, and action items.
